The picked-clean bones of past prey litter the ground at the base of its lair.
A shaft of golden god-rays breaks through the clouds behind, backlighting the creature dramatically.
A storm rolls in across the horizon, lightning flickering deep within the bruised and swollen sky.
A flock of starlings bursts from the treeline below, scattering in blind panic across the frame.
A glowing magical relic pulses with cold light on the rocks just behind the creature's flank.
The moon hangs enormous and pale behind it, dwarfing everything beneath its luminous silver face.
A second, smaller creature cowers at the edge of the scene, watching from a cautious distance.
Lightning splits the sky in a jagged white crack directly above the creature's raised head.
A treasure-hoard glints in the shadow of the cave mouth, gold catching the dim available light.
A broken statue of a hero lies half-toppled in the foreground, its stone fist still raised.
A ruined stone structure sags half-buried behind it, swallowed slowly by centuries of encroaching earth.
A wrecked ship lies broken across the rocks below, its timber ribs splayed open like a ribcage.
Scattered femurs and shattered skulls of old prey ring the flat stone where the creature rests.
God-rays pour through a gap in the storm clouds, a single column of light descending behind it.
A lone crow lifts from the ruined tower beside it, black wings snapping open against pale sky.
A second winged shape circles high overhead, small but unmistakable, waiting its turn patiently.
The storm behind has turned the horizon a deep arterial red, light dying beneath the rolling clouds.
An ancient relic half-buried in the mud glows faintly, its markings still legible after a thousand years.
The full moon sits directly behind the creature's outstretched wing, perfectly framed and impossibly large.
Ribs of an enormous past kill arc from the soil below, yellowed and weathered to chalk.
A crumbling colossus, its heroic face worn featureless, leans at an angle in the mudflat behind.
The hoard beneath it shifts and glints as gold coins spill from a toppled chest into shadow.
A whole murmuration of birds detonates from the valley floor, a black cloud fleeing in all directions.
A foundered galleon rests on the reef below, mast snapped, hull dark with weed and age.
Three jagged lightning bolts strike the ridge behind simultaneously, illuminating everything in a single white instant.
